title: Allow authoritative registry responsibility to be distributed
requirements:
- Replace 'single accountable source' with clearly defined authoritative responsibility that may be distributed across recognised sources
- Either use one term for all registries or explain any intended distinction between index, list, record and source
- Apply the same framing to the Product Registry ('one per country', single steward, consequences of absence)
- Distinguish logical authority from physical storage so 'single source' cannot be read as one repository
- Require coordination, conflict resolution and attribute-level decision rights where authority is distributed
- Note where a registry may be singular, federated or split across authorities
